inputOnlyCampaigns.method: All six missions in full city obstacles, training difficulty, fixed 60 Hz, Leopard 2 A8 input-only pilot. Final defence patrols four points with 5-second orders. Every step checks real building clearance. No health, cooldown, position or outcome overrides.
